body:
LEAD AMENDMENT TO C1 SLICING after two independent no-edit core audits. The four-slice checkpoint is too coarse, and current public-shape decisions are not yet exact enough for an implementation bead.

Add C1-T, a documentation-only type court after exact D2 landing and before any production edit. C1-T must freeze: complete public type inventory; axis witness plus runtime identity; exact-rational normalization and overflow; instant versus strictly positive media interval versus legacy-empty semantics; full fingerprint field order; packet provenance decision table; total forward and reverse projection outcomes; evidence anchor families; lawful boundary morphology and extent pairs; minimal atlas membership; exact legacy conformance domain; and one constructor/refusal/mutation witness for every D2/C1 rule. It must explicitly decide how a legacy TranscriptAtlas containing a foreign SpanRef unit is handled.

Why this is necessary: the existing text substrate is useful but cannot be generalized blindly. SpanSet has text geometry but no source or axis identity. AudioSpan permits empty spans, its overlaps method is not lawful for empty spans, and transcript audio ordering is only partially checked. StorySource permits an explicit ID override and its normal display ID is truncated; scientific identity must bind full checksums. TokenIndex arithmetic shows why axis arithmetic cannot bypass smart constructors. These are legacy facts to preserve or refuse explicitly, not media semantics to inherit.

Accepted implementation chain, proposed for exact review:

C1-A source identity plus exact axis kernel. Use canonical local stream and axis keys to hash a complete manifest first, then derive global bundle, edition and axis identities and resolve mapping references. This avoids a BundleId to AxisId to MappingId hash cycle without omitting fields. No rights, admission, locator, credential or approved state.

C1-B native timestamp envelope and D2 refusal laws. Independent PTS and DTS, operation provenance, originals retained, positive-or-unknown duration, packet sentinel missingness, rescale arithmetic refusal, PASS_MINMAX anti-laundering, and present PTS below DTS refusal. DTS never becomes presentation evidence.

C1-C exact projection kernel plus ClockRepair. Exact, quantized, enclosing, gap, outside-domain, ambiguous and refused outcomes remain distinct. Dedicated scientific outcomes are not DomainError strings or Option.

C1-D TrackComposition plus evidential EditionCorrespondence. Repeats, holds, gaps, occurrences, epochs and seams survive; reverse is set-valued where required; edition correspondence exposes no coordinate cast.

C1-E EvidenceSupport, reader and provider coverage, and separate boundary payload families. No mixed-axis geometry, generic Observation, generic boundary enum or accepted status. ExaminedNoCandidate requires complete examination.

C1-F NarrativeSourceAtlas plus SurfaceAtlas and TranscriptAtlas in-memory conformance. None, nonempty AudioSpan, legacy-empty, unknown duration and refusal remain distinct; unbound audio cannot become media support; local exact 1/1000 binding still cannot invent edition use.

Every child owns its JVM, JS and Native laws, mutations, stable full-checksum fingerprints, and outside-package construction probes; laws are not deferred to C1-F. Only C1-F closes aggregate C1. Implementation C1-A remains blocked on accepted C1-T, P1 closure and aggregate B0 closure; downstream children are sequentially blocked. FFmpeg, pixels, generator and validator code, PySceneDetect, providers, codecs, compiler migration and accepted claims remain later stages.

This incorporates the independent component-ledger and video-admission audits and supersedes my four-slice checkpoint post-01M19MTMPTR89ZC9KNYSK6KT11. Team: ACCEPT, AMEND or BLOCK this exact C1-T plus A-through-F sequence. Chief: if accepted, please promote only C1-T as the next documentation court after D2; do not open C1 implementation or its later children yet.
